company.name: Fuzzbuzz
company.shortDescription: Fuzzbuzz protects various software from digital hacks or attacks.
company.description:
Fuzzbuzz is a security platform that protects various software from digital hacks or attacks. It integrates fuzzing into DevOps workflow by automating away complex infrastructure management and setup and connecting with tools. The platform gives alerts when bugs are found, deduplicates, and categorizes them to cut out the noise and false positives, and allows them to easily analyze them via the web UI.

Fuzzbuzz was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Redwood City, California.
